messages:
Marta (Marketing): Quick sync — CloudVendor reached out to co-run a marketplace launch + joint webinar + benchmark blog. Need owners, a delivery timeline, and inbound routing for trial & demo leads. :wave:

Kevin (Growth): Nice. My recommendation: list the marketplace entry (soft launch) 1 week before the webinar so the event drives traffic to the listing. Also suggests a short demo flow for the listing.

Sophia (Content): I can draft the joint blog and the benchmark narrative. Need partner perf artifacts and a reproducible methodology. Can we get a short test matrix (instance types, dataset, prompts) from CloudVendor by Thu?

Priya (CloudVendor): We will provide a 2-node run, logs, and an ops blurb. Uploading artifacts to the shared "cloudvendor-artifacts" folder by Wednesday EOD.

Alex (PMM): I'll prep marketplace assets: logo, 1-paragraph blurb, long description, screenshots, and the quickstart. Need the final blurb by next Wed. Also vote to include a "Try in 1-click" sandbox link.

Marta (Marketing): Inbound routing proposal: webinar registrants -> Pardot list "cloudvendor_webinar", demo requests -> SFDC queue "CloudVendor_Partners", marketplace trials -> SFDC record type "MarketplaceTrial". High-intent leads (demo + company size >50) -> autopush to #sales-inbound via webhook. Kevin, can your ops team configure the queue & webhook?

Kevin (Growth): Will do. I'll ask Ops to create SFDC queue and set assignment rules for EMEA & NA. Webhook to #sales-inbound for demo requests with lead score >= 70.

Sophia (Content): Messaging angle options for the blog (short):
- "Predictable LLM inference on CloudVendor: cost and latency you can count on"
- "Real benchmarks: Redwood on CloudVendor at scale"
I'll write two versions: technical (bench + method) and customer-facing (value props + CTA).

Alex (PMM): Quickstart snippet for marketplace listing (include in long description):
```
1) Click \"Deploy\" on CloudVendor marketplace
2) Choose Redwood dedicated plan
3) Paste API key and connect
```
Partner needs to route the deploy link to our demo sandbox.

Priya (CloudVendor): We'll enable the deploy link and provide a dev account. Sharing credentials via secure share now. Security team will need to approve access.

Marta (Marketing): Webinar plan (proposal):
- Date: Tue, two weeks out
- Format: 30m content + 15m live Q&A
- Speakers: Kevin (infra demo), Priya (partner product), Sophia (benchmarks + narrative)
- Dry run: 3 business days before the event

Kevin (Growth): I'll do a live failover demo (fallback to smaller model). Sophia, please provide a 10-query canned prompt set + expected outputs for the demo. Include reproducibility steps.

Sophia (Content): On it. I'll attach the prompt set and the benchmark methodology doc to the shared folder.

Marta (Marketing): Lead scoring draft:
- Demo request + company size >50 => MQL
- Marketplace trial >3 sessions in 7 days => Sales Accepted Lead (SAL)
- Webinar attendee + product interest => nurture cadence (3-email sequence)
Also tag all SFDC records with `Partner__c = \"CloudVendor\"` and set utm parameters: `utm_source=cloudvendor & utm_campaign=cloudvendor_launch_apr2026 & utm_medium=partner`.

Alex (PMM): Legal check: need partner-approved quote and logo usage sign-off. Who takes point for legal review?

Marta (Marketing): I'll open the legal review ticket and loop in Legal. Priya, can you share the partner legal boilerplate and approval timeline?

Priya (CloudVendor): Boilerplate uploaded. We can sign the quote by next Tue; need final blurb for the marketplace by Wed.

LegalBot: New doc uploaded: "CloudVendor_co-marketing_terms_v1.pdf". Assigned to Legal (review required).

JiraBot: Created ticket MARKETING-4678: "CloudVendor marketplace + webinar execution" assigned to Marta, Kevin, Alex, Sophia. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MARKETING-4678

Marta (Marketing): Action items summary:
- Kevin: SFDC queue + webhook, own demo reliability & infra prep
- Alex: Marketplace assets, 1-paragraph blurb, quickstart screenshots
- Sophia: Blog draft, benchmark narrative, 10-demo prompts, methodology doc
- Marta: Legal coordination, webinar ops, calendar + dry run scheduling
- Priya: Partner artifacts, dev credentials, quote sign-off

Marta (Marketing): Can each owner confirm deliverable deadlines? I plan to lock the landing page and the webinar registration by EOD Fri if we have the blurb and assets. :calendar:

Kevin (Growth): Confirmed.

Alex (PMM): Confirmed.

Sophia (Content): Confirmed.

Priya (CloudVendor): Confirmed  excited to launch together! :tada:
